message.mdws.practice.symbiont.title: [Symbiont Battle Practice]
message.mdws.practice.symbiont.intro: You have entered the practice arena. Prepare your equipment, then click the text below to begin.
message.mdws.practice.symbiont.info: Symbiont info: it uses melee attacks, spells, and summoned creatures. Keep your distance while it is casting.
message.mdws.practice.symbiont.strategy: How to win: use the shield to block attacks, attack after its spells end or when it is vulnerable, and keep dodging area spells.
message.mdws.practice.symbiont.started: Practice started. The symbiont has spawned!
message.mdws.practice.symbiont.spawn_fai: The symbiont could not spawn. Create a new practice world and try again.
message.mdws.practice.story_in_progress: The story is in progress. Please wait.
message.mdws.practice.already_started: The symbiont battle has already started.
message.mdws.practice.not_in_arena: You are not in the symbiont practice arena.
message.mdws.practice.symbiont.story.ori: The Withered Symbiont is a split-off creature released by the Wither Storm to disperse excess energy.
message.mdws.practice.symbiont.story.hea: It has 60 health (30 hearts) and is released near the Wither Storm when it reaches its maximum growth.
message.mdws.practice.symbiont.story.app: It resembles a gigantic corrupted zombie, with several unfinished storm tentacles growing from the energy source on its back.
message.mdws.practice.symbiont.story.arm: Its body is covered in Wither Storm-like block armor. No attack except command-based attacks can damage the armor.
message.mdws.practice.symbiont.story.wea: Its only weakness is the energy source on its back. Only attacks against that point can deal real damage.
message.mdws.practice.symbiont.story.att: It quickly releases two attack rounds, then uses Corruption Spread to summon corrupted creatures before briefly resting.
message.mdws.practice.symbiont.story.res: While resting, it cannot see or move and fully exposes the energy source on its back. This is the best time to attack.
message.mdws.practice.symbiont.story.cou: When you hear this sound from the Withered Symbiont, it is the best time to counterattack!

screen.mdws.storm_escape.command_block.t: Impulse requires 4 hits; Chain requires 6; Repeating requires 8 and frequently launches flaming Wither Storm missiles; Rainbow starts at 12 hits, gains 1 hit per absorbed unbreakable block, and deals physical melee damage while pulling entities
screen.mdws.storm_escape.command_block.h: Hard Mode upgrades automatically by Storm Points: below 10 is Impulse; 10 or more is Chain; 20 or more is Repeating; 40 or more is Rainbow
screen.mdws.storm_escape.mode.classic.in: Classic Mode initial conditions: the player spawns at (0, 0) with an amulet; before summoning, the border radius is 15, only Wither Skeleton Skulls may be placed or broken, and containers are locked; during preparation, hunger and saturation stay full and Resistance V is applied; these protections are removed when the game starts; after the Wither Storm spawns, the border is restored and thunderstorms are locked on.

screen.mdws.multiplayer.server_ore_rules: Dedicated server defaults are controlled by config/mdws-server.toml. This panel only changes safe per-match, non-generation rules. World-generation rules such as ores are locked here, and config changes only affect newly generated chunks.
screen.mdws.multiplayer.rules.non_leader: Every participant receives an amulet. Each player consumes their own revive count on death; after running out, they spectate until the match ends. The challenge fails when all participants are eliminated.
screen.mdws.multiplayer.rules.leader_esc: Only the leader receives an amulet. As long as the leader is alive, the other participants can respawn infinitely. If the leader dies, the challenge ends immediately.
screen.mdws.multiplayer.section.hunter_i: Hunter Escape / Storm Avatar Initial Rules
screen.mdws.multiplayer.rules.hunter:
Hunters have unlimited respawns, while the summoner has only one life.
Hunters can use a compass to locate the summoner; the summoner can use the amulet to locate hunters, but can track at most four hunters at once.
screen.mdws.multiplayer.rules.hunter_var: In Storm Avatar mode, one hunter becomes the Wither Storm and personally hunts the summoner; this mode requires a compatible morph mod.
